jobs.title: Dermatologist Wanted for Multidisciplinary Clinic Expansion in Markham
jobs.description_summary:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a comprehensive team of allied health professionals. We are expanding our footprint into Markham and are seeking a part-time or full-time Dermatologist to join o...
jobs.full_description_text:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a comprehensive team of allied health professionals. We are expanding our footprint into Markham and are seeking a part-time or full-time Dermatologist to join our growing team.

Our model emphasizes collaborative, patient-centred care with strong internal referral pathways, efficient workflows, and a supportive clinical environment. The Markham site is being developed to serve a diverse and growing population, with significant demand for both medical and procedural dermatology.




The Role

We are seeking a Dermatologist to establish and grow a dermatology practice within our new Markham location. The role includes assessment, diagnosis, and longitudinal management of a wide range of dermatologic conditions, including but not limited to:

General medical dermatology (acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea)
Skin cancer screening and lesion assessment
Minor dermatologic procedures and excisions
Cosmetic dermatology (optional, based on interest)

You will benefit from a strong internal referral base from family physicians and specialists within Unify Health, as well as external referrals. The practice can be tailored to your clinical interests, whether focused on medical, procedural, or cosmetic dermatology.

Our clinic is supported by experienced nursing staff and clinical assistants who assist with patient flow, documentation, coordination of investigations, and follow-ups—allowing you to focus on clinical care. You will have autonomy over your schedule, patient volume, and clinical scope.




Why Join Us

Strong Referral Network: Immediate access to a high-volume internal and external referral base
Flexible Practice Model: Full control over clinic structure, scheduling, and scope of practice
Supportive Infrastructure: Dedicated clinical and administrative support to optimize efficiency
Competitive Compensation: Attractive and competitive split with transparent structure
Collaborative Environment: Work within a well-established, physician-led multidisciplinary team
Modern Facilities: Purpose-built clinical space designed for efficiency and patient experience
Technology-Enabled Practice: Accuro EMR with templates and workflow supports to reduce administrative burden
Proven Track Record: Established history of supporting specialists in building successful, sustainable practices




Additional Considerations

Knowledge of Mandarin, Cantonese, or other Chinese languages is considered an asset given the local patient population, but is not required
Opportunities for cross-referral and collaboration with internal medicine, plastic surgery, and other specialties




Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit a CV and cover letter to ***@unifyhealth.ca (🔒 Premium)




We look forward to discussing how your dermatology practice can grow within Unify Health’s expanding Markham site.

jobs.full_description_text:
DERMATOLOGIST or PEDIATRICIAN SPECIALIZING IN DERMATOLOGY, full-time or part-time, wanted for a multi-disciplinary clinic at either Kidcrew location

Midtown: Bathurst and St Clair

North York: Leslie and 401

DAYTIME OR AFTER-HOURS POSITIONS AVAILABLE

 

The offices are brand new. The EMR is PS Suite (Telus).

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

Kidcrew is an award-winning multi-disciplinary pediatric practice located in Midtown Toronto and North York. We have over 80,000 patients.

 

Our Virtual Care Clinic serves kids from anywhere in Ontario.

Our virtual-care model provides flexibility to allow doctors to augment with casual, part-time, or full-time work.

Cloud-based, HIPAA/PHIPA compliant EMR with VPN access from home.

Chart, bill, order labs/imaging/write sick notes/referrals and discharge notes from anywhere you want!

Guaranteed patient volume (4-6/hr) depending on preference. 

ZERO EMR fee.

Competitive overhead rate.

Overhead is tax-deductible as an associate (versus an employee at other clinics).

Bill upwards of $500/hour

Commitment is casual or long-term. You can pick up as much or as little as you want. When you want to work, how long, and how frequently you see patients, it's up to you.

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

 

Who do we serve?

We can see patients from anywhere in Ontario, including in rural, northern, and underserviced areas. Telemedicine can improve the health and well-being of patients who have poor access to care or can only use the ER. We can help improve access and, therefore, patients' overall health and well-being in these areas. We are thrilled to help more families with timely expert pediatric care.

 

Patient Follow Up

Kidcrew clinicians collaborate to ensure patients have timely and accessible follow-up, in order to avoid unnecessary emergency room use and ensure continuity of care.

 

Flexible patient encounters: urgent visits, consults or follow-ups, in person or via virtual medicine.

 

Flexibility in hours: the ability to work part-time, FT, evenings, or weekends 

 

Work alongside specialists: with over 20 different medical and surgical specialties affiliated

 

Attractive fee split

 

Requirement: CPSO licensed

This is an excellent opportunity to build or relocate a practice in a highly populated residential area.

The clinic is open seven days a week.

**New Graduates Encouraged to Apply**

 

About Kidcrew

At Kidcrew, we have created forward-thinking and innovative children's clinics focusing on family-centred care and wellness for children of all ages. We are looking to bring on excellent, eager, and friendly pediatricians and specialists. Pediatricians will provide well-baby care, sick visits, and general pediatrics to this thriving community. In addition, the clinic provides nursing care.

We are passionate about providing quality pediatric care for kids and families. A state-of-the-art EMR is used along with well-qualified friendly, trained support staff. 

From our friendly front desk staff to our non-traditional 2,000 square-foot patient lounges with a playground, iPad stations, and a playroom, Kidcrew is committed to providing an exceptional patient experience. We have over 120 clinicians on our team: pediatricians, a variety of pediatric sub-specialists, dietitians, speech-language pathologists, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, and others to provide a comprehensive and collaborative model under one roof. 

Join us on our journey to reinventing kids' healthcare.

https://kidcrew.com/

 

Our founder, Dr Dina Kulik, is happy to review opportunities at ***@kidcrew.com (🔒 Premium)

LOCUM DERMATOLOGIST, St. Joseph’s Health Centre, Unity Health Toronto




Unity Health Toronto is inviting applications for a locum position in the Division of Dermatology at the St. Joseph’s Health Centre site in Toronto.

St. Joseph’s Health Centre is a key site within Unity Health Toronto, servin...
jobs.full_description_text:
LOCUM DERMATOLOGIST, St. Joseph’s Health Centre, Unity Health Toronto




Unity Health Toronto is inviting applications for a locum position in the Division of Dermatology at the St. Joseph’s Health Centre site in Toronto.

St. Joseph’s Health Centre is a key site within Unity Health Toronto, serving a culturally and economically diverse population of approximately 530,000. The hospital is a 400-bed facility that employs around 2,500 staff and includes 500 credentialed physicians. Recently, the hospital received a $1 billion investment from the Province of Ontario to build a state-of-the-art patient tower. Unity Health Toronto’s mission is to deliver compassionate care and advance healthcare excellence through education, research, and innovation. The Department of Medicine at St. Joseph’s Health Centre includes over 130 physicians across 13 divisions, committed to clinical care, education, and hospital leadership. Department members actively participate in undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing education programs at the University of Toronto, frequently earning teaching awards.

The Opportunity:

The successful candidate will join the Division of Dermatology in the Department of Medicine and will have access to outpatient clinic time in general dermatology at the newly renovated Ambulatory Care Centre within the hospital. They will also provide shared daytime coverage for inpatient dermatology consultations on clinic days, rotating with our current dermatologists. 

The ideal candidate will have an interest in general dermatology and medical dermatology. The successful candidate must possess exemplary clinical skills and professionalism, with evidence of excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills and a proven ability to work effectively in a team. The role will also involve joining the University of Toronto Division of Dermatology with ample opportunities for involvement in medical education for residents and medical students with two core dermatology residency rotations based at our site. Compensation will be through OHIP billings (fee-for-service).

Applicants must be proficient in English and eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto at the rank of Lecturer or higher. Certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, along with licensure by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario, is required. Candidates must also hold Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) coverage or an equivalent in good standing. The start for this position is spring/summer 2026, or as mutually agreed.




The University of Toronto and Unity Health Toronto are strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized persons, persons of colour, women, Indigenous/Aboriginal People of North America, persons with disability, LGBTQ persons, and others who may contribute to further diversification of ideas. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority.

jobs.full_description_text:
DERMATOLOGIST or PEDIATRICIAN SPECIALIZING IN DERMATOLOGY, full-time or part-time, wanted for a multi-disciplinary clinic at either Kidcrew location

Midtown: Bathurst and St Clair

North York: Leslie and 401

DAYTIME OR AFTER-HOURS POSITIONS AVAILABLE

 

The offices are brand new. The EMR is PS Suite (Telus).

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

Kidcrew is an award-winning multi-disciplinary pediatric practice located in Midtown Toronto and North York. We have over 80,000 patients.

 

Our Virtual Care Clinic serves kids from anywhere in Ontario.

Our virtual-care model provides flexibility to allow doctors to augment with casual, part-time, or full-time work.

Cloud-based, HIPAA/PHIPA compliant EMR with VPN access from home.

Chart, bill, order labs/imaging/write sick notes/referrals and discharge notes from anywhere you want!

Guaranteed patient volume (4-6/hr) depending on preference. 

ZERO EMR fee.

Competitive overhead rate.

Overhead is tax-deductible as an associate (versus an employee at other clinics).

Bill upwards of $500/hour

Commitment is casual or long-term. You can pick up as much or as little as you want. When you want to work, how long, and how frequently you see patients, it's up to you.

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

 

Who do we serve?

We can see patients from anywhere in Ontario, including in rural, northern, and underserviced areas. Telemedicine can improve the health and well-being of patients who have poor access to care or can only use the ER. We can help improve access and, therefore, patients' overall health and well-being in these areas. We are thrilled to help more families with timely expert pediatric care.

 

Patient Follow Up

Kidcrew clinicians collaborate to ensure patients have timely and accessible follow-up, in order to avoid unnecessary emergency room use and ensure continuity of care.

 

Flexible patient encounters: urgent visits, consults or follow-ups, in person or via virtual medicine.

 

Flexibility in hours: the ability to work part-time, FT, evenings, or weekends 

 

Work alongside specialists: with over 20 different medical and surgical specialties affiliated

 

Attractive fee split

 

Requirement: CPSO licensed

This is an excellent opportunity to build or relocate a practice in a highly populated residential area.

The clinic is open seven days a week.

**New Graduates Encouraged to Apply**

 

About Kidcrew

At Kidcrew, we have created forward-thinking and innovative children's clinics focusing on family-centred care and wellness for children of all ages. We are looking to bring on excellent, eager, and friendly pediatricians and specialists. Pediatricians will provide well-baby care, sick visits, and general pediatrics to this thriving community. In addition, the clinic provides nursing care.

We are passionate about providing quality pediatric care for kids and families. A state-of-the-art EMR is used along with well-qualified friendly, trained support staff. 

From our friendly front desk staff to our non-traditional 2,000 square-foot patient lounges with a playground, iPad stations, and a playroom, Kidcrew is committed to providing an exceptional patient experience. We have over 120 clinicians on our team: pediatricians, a variety of pediatric sub-specialists, dietitians, speech-language pathologists, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, and others to provide a comprehensive and collaborative model under one roof. 

Join us on our journey to reinventing kids' healthcare.

https://kidcrew.com/

 

Our founder, Dr Dina Kulik, is happy to review opportunities at ***@kidcrew.com (🔒 Premium)

The University of Toronto at St. Joseph’s Hospital, Unity Health Toronto, in downtown west Toronto is recruiting for 1 general dermatologist for 2026. E.Dahlke, Division Head, Dermatology, SJHC

***@gmail.com (🔒 Premium)




------------------------------------------------------------------




 

DERMATOLOGIST, St. Joseph’s Health Centre, Unity Health Toronto

Unity Health Toronto is inviting applications for an Active Staff position in the Division of Dermatology at the St. Joseph’s Health Centre site in Toronto.

St. Joseph’s Health Centre is a key site within Unity Health Toronto, serving a culturally and economically diverse population of approximately 530,000. The hospital is a 400-bed facility that employs around 2,500 staff and includes 500 credentialed physicians. Recently, the hospital received a $1 billion investment from the Province of Ontario to build a state-of-the-art patient tower. Unity Health Toronto’s mission is to deliver compassionate care and advance healthcare excellence through education, research, and innovation. The Department of Medicine at St. Joseph’s Health Centre includes over 130 physicians across 13 divisions, committed to clinical care, education, and hospital leadership. Department members actively participate in undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing education programs at the University of Toronto, frequently earning teaching awards. The Department supports a comprehensive patient care experience, from acute to post-acute care.

The Opportunity:

The successful candidate will join a team of two dermatologists, one pediatric dermatologist, one wound care specialist, and one Mohs surgeon/dermatologist. The selected candidate will have access to outpatient clinic time in general dermatology at the newly renovated Ambulatory Care Centre within the hospital. Depending on the candidates interests there may be additional opportunity to work in a pediatric dermatology clinic, wound care specialty clinic, and/or monthly minor surgery clinics. They will also provide shared daytime coverage for inpatient dermatology consultations, rotating with our current dermatologists. The ideal candidate will have an interest in general dermatology and medical dermatology. Subspecialty training in complex medical dermatology, an interest in education, research, and or quality improvement/patient satisfaction would be considered assets but are not required. Compensation will be through OHIP billings (fee-for-service).

The successful candidate must possess exemplary clinical skills and professionalism, with evidence of excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills and a proven ability to work effectively in a team. 

The role will also involve joining the University of Toronto Division of Dermatology with ample opportunities for involvement in medical education for residents and medical students with two core dermatology residency rotations based at our site. 

Applicants must be proficient in English and eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto at the rank of Lecturer or higher. Certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, along with licensure by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario, is required. Candidates must also hold Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) coverage or an equivalent in good standing.

The start for this position is spring/summer 2026, or as mutually agreed.

Questions about the position can be directed to Dr. Erin Dahlke, Division Head, Dermatology, St. Joseph's Health Centre (***@gmail.com (🔒 Premium), ***@unityhealth.to (🔒 Premium))

Interested applicants should submit their curriculum vitae and the names of three references to Dr. Urszula Zurawska-Fortin, Chief of Medicine, St. Joseph's Health Centre, ***@unityhealth.to (🔒 Premium)

Dr. Urszula Zurawska-Fortin, Chief of Medicine, St. Joseph’s Health Centre, Unity Health Toronto, 30 The Queensway, Room 1S-124, Toronto, ON, M6R1B5, ***@unityhealth.to (🔒 Premium)

The University of Toronto and Unity Health Toronto are strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized persons, persons of colour, women, Indigenous/Aboriginal People of North America, persons with disability, LGBTQ persons, and others who may contribute to further diversification of ideas. jobs.full_description_text:
DERMATOLOGIST or PEDIATRICIAN SPECIALIZING IN DERMATOLOGY, full-time or part-time, wanted for a multi-disciplinary clinic at either Kidcrew location

Midtown: Bathurst and St Clair

North York: Leslie and 401

DAYTIME OR AFTER-HOURS POSITIONS AVAILABLE

 

The offices are brand new. The EMR is PS Suite (Telus).

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

Kidcrew is an award-winning multi-disciplinary pediatric practice located in Midtown Toronto and North York. We have over 80,000 patients.

 

Our Virtual Care Clinic serves kids from anywhere in Ontario.

Our virtual-care model provides flexibility to allow doctors to augment with casual, part-time, or full-time work.

Cloud-based, HIPAA/PHIPA compliant EMR with VPN access from home.

Chart, bill, order labs/imaging/write sick notes/referrals and discharge notes from anywhere you want!

Guaranteed patient volume (4-6/hr) depending on preference. 

ZERO EMR fee.

Competitive overhead rate.

Overhead is tax-deductible as an associate (versus an employee at other clinics).

Bill upwards of $500/hour

Commitment is casual or long-term. You can pick up as much or as little as you want. When you want to work, how long, and how frequently you see patients, it's up to you.

Our professional office staff handles all the administrative tasks.

 

Who do we serve?

We can see patients from anywhere in Ontario, including in rural, northern, and underserviced areas. Telemedicine can improve the health and well-being of patients who have poor access to care or can only use the ER. We can help improve access and, therefore, patients' overall health and well-being in these areas. We are thrilled to help more families with timely expert pediatric care.

 

Patient Follow Up

Kidcrew clinicians collaborate to ensure patients have timely and accessible follow-up, in order to avoid unnecessary emergency room use and ensure continuity of care.

 

Flexible patient encounters: urgent visits, consults or follow-ups, in person or via virtual medicine.

 

Flexibility in hours: the ability to work part-time, FT, evenings, or weekends 

 

Work alongside specialists: with over 20 different medical and surgical specialties affiliated

 

Attractive fee split

 

Requirement: CPSO licensed

This is an excellent opportunity to build or relocate a practice in a highly populated residential area.

The clinic is open seven days a week.

**New Graduates Encouraged to Apply**

 

About Kidcrew

At Kidcrew, we have created forward-thinking and innovative children's clinics focusing on family-centred care and wellness for children of all ages. We are looking to bring on excellent, eager, and friendly pediatricians and specialists. Pediatricians will provide well-baby care, sick visits, and general pediatrics to this thriving community. In addition, the clinic provides nursing care.

We are passionate about providing quality pediatric care for kids and families. A state-of-the-art EMR is used along with well-qualified friendly, trained support staff. 

From our friendly front desk staff to our non-traditional 2,000 square-foot patient lounges with a playground, iPad stations, and a playroom, Kidcrew is committed to providing an exceptional patient experience. We have over 120 clinicians on our team: pediatricians, a variety of pediatric sub-specialists, dietitians, speech-language pathologists, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, and others to provide a comprehensive and collaborative model under one roof. 

Join us on our journey to reinventing kids' healthcare.

https://kidcrew.com/

 

Our founder, Dr Dina Kulik, is happy to review opportunities at ***@kidcrew.com (🔒 Premium)

jobs.description_summary:
Humber River Health. Tomorrow’s Healthcare, Today.

jobs.full_description_text:
Humber River Health. Tomorrow’s Healthcare, Today. 

 

Humber River Health is a multi-site organization serving a population of more than 850,000 people in the northwest Greater Toronto Area. The organization is a member of the Toronto Academic Health Science Network (TAHSN) and operates Hennick Humber Hospital, along with its Finch and Church campuses, supported by more than 5,000 employees, approximately 800 physicians, and over 600 volunteers.

 

Hennick Humber Hospital is North America’s first fully digital hospital. Through robotics and advanced technology, patients benefit from less pain, fewer complications, and shorter hospital stays. A custom combination of technology and clinical expertise supports a reimagined model of care focused on safety, efficiency, and improved outcomes. Its digital ecosystem includes automated laboratory services, medication management robotics, electronic health records, a Command Centre, computerized physician order entry, bedside computer terminals, and surgical tracking systems that keep families informed in real time.

 

These innovations enhance communication, improve efficiency, and create a more connected experience for patients and families.

 

This transformation has been made possible through the dedication of Humber’s staff, physicians, and volunteers. Together, they are united by a shared belief: the power to transform healthcare through innovation, collaboration, and excellence. With strong teams and a commitment to continuous improvement, Humber River Health continues to deliver Tomorrow’s Healthcare, Today.

 




 

We are looking for a:

 

Emergency Physician

 

Department and Program Overview

 

Department of Emergency Medicine

 

Position Summary

 

The Department of Emergency Medicine is seeking Emergency Physicians who are passionate about practicing the full spectrum of emergency medicine in a high-volume, academically engaged community hospital. Successful candidates will join a collaborative team and participate in a balanced schedule that includes day, evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts.

 

Qualifications, Skills and Attributes

 

Certification in Emergency Medicine from the College of Family Physicians of Canada or hold a fellowship in Emergency Medicine from the Royal college of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada

License to practice and in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario

An interest in pediatrics, care of the elderly, POCUS, academics or research will be consider an assist but not mandatory.

 

In addition to demonstrated clinical excellence and outstanding interpersonal skills, candidates must be a qualified medical practitioner and a member of, or eligible for membership, with the College of Physicians & Surgeons of Ontario. Candidates must also have relevant certification from the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC).

As a member of TAHSN, HRH provides placements for medical learners at all levels. The successful candidate will have a recognized interest in education initiatives, including the teaching, supervision and mentoring of medical learners. Applicants must have or be eligible for a faculty appointment in the appropriate clinical department at the Temerty Faculty of Medicine, University of Toronto.

 

 

Interested Applicants

 

Applications will be accepted until August 7th, however, the position will remain open until filled or recruitment is closed.

 

We encourage all interested candidates to apply in confidence by forwarding: (1) Letter of Interest and (2) up-to-date curriculum vitae 

 

Application package should be submitted to: 

 

 

Dr. Tajinder Kaura

Humber River Health

1235 Wilson Avenue

Toronto, ON M3M 0B2

 

Send via email: ***@hrh.ca (🔒 Premium)

 

 

Why choose Humber River Health?

 

At Humber River Health, our staff, physicians, and volunteers are delivering Tomorrow's Healthcare, Today. We are proud to have been recognized as a part of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers by Mediacorp Canada Inc. We support employees by providing evidence-based leadership and cultivating a culture that consistently wows with our unwavering commitment to staff, physician and volunteer engagement. We are dedicated to high-quality patient care and demonstrate our values of compassion, professionalism, and respect.

 

Humber River Health is committed to creating an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace that reflects the diversity of our communities. Guided by our strategic direction to embed equity, diversity and inclusion in everything we do – and to address systemic barriers – we foster a culture where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute.

 

We welcome applications from individuals of all equity-deserving groups, including Indigenous peoples, racialized communities, persons living with disabilities, women, 2SLGBTQ+ individuals and seniors. We recognize that diverse identities and perspectives strengthen our ability to deliver safe, innovative and compassionate care.

 

As an equal opportunity employer, Humber River Health complies with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or any other protected ground.

 

Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and employment. Please contact our recruitment team to discuss your needs confidentially.

 

This position is being posted in response to an existing vacancy at Humber River Health.

 

The hospital reserves the right not to appoint anyone to this position.

www.hrh.ca

jobs.title: Division of Paediatric Emergency Medicine. Faculty position
jobs.description_summary: Effective immediately The Division of Paediatric Emergency Medicine is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position at the Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), 555 University Ave., Toronto, ON which is an academic health science centre dedicated to the care of children: affiliated with the Unive...
jobs.full_description_text:
Effective immediately The Division of Paediatric Emergency Medicine is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position at the Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), 555 University Ave., Toronto, ON which is an academic health science centre dedicated to the care of children: affiliated with the University of Toronto.

The Emergency Department at SickKids sees more than 70,000 patient visits per year and is the Paediatric Level 1 Trauma Centre for the greater Toronto area. The division trains a broad range of practitioners who care for ill and injured children, the centerpiece of the division’s training mission is our fully accredited Fellowship training Program which matriculates Royal College fellows and international PEM fellows.

Formally trained PEM physicians with outstanding clinical skills and a commitment to academic success are encouraged to apply. International candidates with a strong academic portfolio, PEM fellowship training, and experience in an academic teaching center will be considered. Candidates with additional specialized training in machine learning, robotics, or pre-hospital medicine are preferred.

The successful candidate will be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($268,340 – $318,823) per annum will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be eligible for a benefit package which includes medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability insurance, group insurance, pension plan, vision care, academic allowance, and a relocation package.

All candidates must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario.

Interested individuals should submit a letter of application and a curriculum vitae with the names and addresses of three references to Dr. Jason Fischer, Head, Division of Emergency Medicine,

The Hospital for Sick Children, 555 University Avenue, Toronto, ON M5G 1X8, Canada, or email ***@sickkids.ca (🔒 Premium).

For additional information regarding the Department of Paediatrics see http://www.sickkids.ca/paediatrics/. This position will remain open until filled.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, in accordance with Canadian immigration requirements, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority. Only those applicants selected for the interview will be contacted.

jobs.description_summary:
SUNNYBROOK EMERGENCY MEDICINE

Are you an Emergency Physician seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity in a dynamic and progressive healthcare environment? Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre is seeking passionate individuals to join our team. We are always on the lookout for ambitious physicia...
jobs.full_description_text:
SUNNYBROOK EMERGENCY MEDICINE

Are you an Emergency Physician seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity in a dynamic and progressive healthcare environment? Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre is seeking passionate individuals to join our team. We are always on the lookout for ambitious physicians who aim to leave their mark on the emergency medicine landscape, and we are fully dedicated to supporting you every step of the way to reach your goals. Sunnybrook is a tertiary care hospital in the heart of the Greater Toronto Area with 1.2 million patient visits annually including 64,000 ED visits. We serve as a regional referral centre for diverse specialties, including burns, stroke, cancer, interventional cardiology, neurosurgery, vascular, spinal surgery, and high-risk maternal/neonatal care. We function as the base hospital for Toronto EMS and are proud to be Canada’s largest trauma centre and the first hospital in Canada to be accredited by the American College of Surgeons as a Level 1 Trauma Centre. 

We are a collaborative and collegial group of approximately 45 physicians with a commitment to academic success and clinical excellence. We prioritize group wellness and flexible scheduling due to our varied practice patterns and interests. These interests include pre-hospital care, quality improvement and patient safety, health services research, virtual care, technological innovation, ultrasound, and medical education. Clinically, we function in a well-resourced environment with a diverse, complex patient population. We have unparalleled support from specialist consultants and allied health, as well as comprehensive options for follow-up to ensure our patients receive the best care during and after their ED visit.

 Sunnybrook is fully affiliated with the University of Toronto and a core training site for the Emergency Medicine Residency Program and various Postgraduate and Fellowship Programs. Our staff are well-established leaders in medical education. We are a lead site for the residency program’s POCUS training, and our simulation program offers both teaching and continuing professional development opportunities in a high-fidelity, interprofessional, team-based environment.

 Duties:

· Provide exemplary, efficient, and patient-centred clinical care

jobs.description_summary: Effective immediately The Division of Paediatric Emergency Medicine is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position at the Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), 555 University Ave., Toronto, ON which is an academic health science centre dedicated to the care of children: affiliated with the Unive...
jobs.full_description_text:
Effective immediately The Division of Paediatric Emergency Medicine is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position at the Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), 555 University Ave., Toronto, ON which is an academic health science centre dedicated to the care of children: affiliated with the University of Toronto.

The Emergency Department at SickKids sees more than 70,000 patient visits per year and is the Paediatric Level 1 Trauma Centre for the greater Toronto area. The division trains a broad range of practitioners who care for ill and injured children, the centerpiece of the division’s training mission is our fully accredited Fellowship training Program which matriculates Royal College fellows and international PEM fellows.

Formally trained PEM physicians with outstanding clinical skills and a commitment to academic success are encouraged to apply. International candidates with a strong academic portfolio, PEM fellowship training, and experience in an academic teaching center will be considered. Candidates with additional specialized training in machine learning, robotics, or pre-hospital medicine are preferred.

The successful candidate will be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($268,340 – $318,823) per annum will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be eligible for a benefit package which includes medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability insurance, group insurance, pension plan, vision care, academic allowance, and a relocation package.

All candidates must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario.

Interested individuals should submit a letter of application and a curriculum vitae with the names and addresses of three references to Dr. Jason Fischer, Head, Division of Emergency Medicine,

The Hospital for Sick Children, 555 University Avenue, Toronto, ON M5G 1X8, Canada, or email ***@sickkids.ca (🔒 Premium).

For additional information regarding the Department of Paediatrics see http://www.sickkids.ca/paediatrics/. This position will remain open until filled.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, in accordance with Canadian immigration requirements, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority. Only those applicants selected for the interview will be contacted.

International candidates with a strong academic portfolio, PEM fellowship training, and experience in an academic teaching center will be considered. Candidates with additional specialized training in machine learning, robotics, or pre-hospital medicine are preferred. The successful candidate will be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($268,340 – $318,823) per annum will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be eligible for a benefit package which includes medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability insurance, group insurance, pension plan, vision care, academic allowance, and a relocation package. All candidates must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario. Interested individuals should submit a letter of application and a curriculum vitae with the names and addresses of three references to Dr. Jason Fischer, Head, Division of Emergency Medicine, The Hospital for Sick Children, 555 University Avenue, Toronto, ON M5G 1X8, Canada, or email jason.fischer@sickkids.ca . For additional information regarding the Department of Paediatrics see http://www.sickkids.ca/paediatrics/ . This position will remain open until filled. The University of Toronto and The Hospital for Sick Children are strongly committed to diversity within its community. Both institutions recognize systemic barriers that impact equity seeking groups. As such, we welcome applications from historically marginalized groups including Black, Indigenous, and Racialized people, women, LGBTQIA+, and/or persons with disabilities. The Department recognizes and fairly considers the impact of leaves (e.g., family care or health-related) that may contribute to career interruptions or slowdowns. Candidates are encouraged to signal any leave that affected productivity, or that may have influenced their career path. This information will be considered to ensure the equitable assessment of the candidate’s record. The Department further supports an employment equity program and encourages members of designated equity groups to self-identify. It further seeks to ensure equitable treatment and full inclusion of persons with disabilities. Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence, Meagan Cameira, Executive Assistant to the Chair at meagan.cameira@sickkids.ca or 416.813.6122. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, in accordance with Canadian immigration requirements, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority. Only those applicants selected for the interview will be contacted.

jobs.full_description_text:
SUNNYBROOK EMERGENCY MEDICINE

Are you an Emergency Physician seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity in a dynamic and progressive healthcare environment? Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre is seeking passionate individuals to join our team. We are always on the lookout for ambitious physicians who aim to leave their mark on the emergency medicine landscape, and we are fully dedicated to supporting you every step of the way to reach your goals. Sunnybrook is a tertiary care hospital in the heart of the Greater Toronto Area with 1.2 million patient visits annually including 64,000 ED visits. We serve as a regional referral centre for diverse specialties, including burns, stroke, cancer, interventional cardiology, neurosurgery, vascular, spinal surgery, and high-risk maternal/neonatal care. We function as the base hospital for Toronto EMS and are proud to be Canada’s largest trauma centre and the first hospital in Canada to be accredited by the American College of Surgeons as a Level 1 Trauma Centre.

We are a collaborative and collegial group of approximately 45 physicians with a commitment to academic success and clinical excellence. We prioritize group wellness and flexible scheduling due to our varied practice patterns and interests. These interests include pre-hospital care, quality improvement and patient safety, health services research, virtual care, technological innovation, ultrasound, and medical education. Clinically, we function in a well-resourced environment with a diverse, complex patient population. We have unparalleled support from specialist consultants and allied health, as well as comprehensive options for follow-up to ensure our patients receive the best care during and after their ED visit. 

Sunnybrook is fully affiliated with the University of Toronto and a core training site for the Emergency Medicine Residency Program and various Postgraduate and Fellowship Programs. Our staff are well-established leaders in medical education. We are a lead site for the residency program’s POCUS training, and our simulation program offers both teaching and continuing professional development opportunities in a high-fidelity, interprofessional, team-based environment.

Duties:

- Provide exemplary, efficient, and patient-centred clinical care

- Supervise and support bedside teaching of trainees

- Provide medical consults to in-field paramedic teams through our patch program

- Contribute to the academic priorities of the University through education, quality improvement, research, and/or administration

Requirements:

- FRCPC, CCFP-EM or DABEM certified in Emergency Medicine

- MD or equivalent 

- English proficiency 

- Eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario 

- Strong clinical and teaching skills

- Though all are welcome to apply, Canadian citizens and permanent residents will be given priority

Remuneration:

Estimated compensation of $300,000-$400,000 per year based on full-time clinical work and academic contributions via our Alternate Funding Arrangement (AFA) and academic work via our Alternate Funding Plan (AFP). 

To apply, please submit the following documents by end of the day September 2, 2025:

- Cover letter

- Curriculum vitae

- Three referee names and email addresses (including your most recent ED Chief or Program Director)

Submit to Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre, care of Dr. Justin Hall, Chief, Department of Emergency Medicine (***@sunnybrook.ca (🔒 Premium)" target="_blank">***@sunnybrook.ca (🔒 Premium)) and Ms. Paola Tiveron (***@sunnybrook.ca (🔒 Premium)" target="_blank">***@sunnybrook.ca (🔒 Premium)). We will contact each of your three referees. For further inquiries or to arrange a meeting, please email us to schedule a virtual discussion.

jobs.full_description_text:
Job type: Full-time, Part-time or Flexible

 

MDSearch is recruiting Internists with a cardiology focus to join a dynamic and progressive team in Toronto, Ontario. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or experienced professionals seeking dynamic environments.

 

As a General Internist, your role will involve delivering comprehensive care to patients with cardiac and vascular conditions, while also performing diagnostic procedures. You will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team that includes Cardiologists, General Internists, and specialized cardiac care nurses to ensure the highest standard of patient care.

 

This position offers the chance to work in a modern, well-equipped facility with a talented and experienced team. It presents a valuable opportunity to enhance your clinical expertise and contribute to advancements in cardiac and vascular care. Whether you’re looking for a full-time, part-time, or flexible schedule, this role provides a fulfilling career path in cardiology, enabling you to make a meaningful impact on patients' health and well-being.

 

ABOUT THE CLINIC

The clinic offers a full range of diagnostic services, including nuclear testing, echocardiograms, cardiac sonography, stress tests, stress echo testing, Holter monitoring, and blood pressure monitoring.

 

This professionally managed clinic is dedicated to delivering the highest quality patient care. A skilled team ensures all administrative and clinical operations are handled to an exceptional standard, allowing physicians to focus entirely on patient care. As part of an established and integral cardiology service in the region, the clinic offers a comprehensive range of diagnostic testing. You will join a team that understands each patient is unique and strives to develop personalized treatment plans for everyone.

 




Requirements
Independent Practice Certificate of Registration from the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario (CPSO)
Membership in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario (CPSO)
Royal College certification in General Internal Medicine (or pending certification)
US-trained specialists are exempt from The Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons eligibility requirements (US Board Certified Physicians are eligible for an independent license in Ontario)
Internationally trained candidates who pass the subspecialty exam being launched by the CPSO (College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario) will be considered
Medical liability insurance from the Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) or equivalent required, appropriate to the category of practice
Benefits
100% of your billing during the first month to support your ramp-up period
Competitive overhead
Set your own schedule, including evenings and weekends
Control your patient volume to maximize income. 
Partnership opportunities available in future
Dedicated administrative, medical records personnel, nuclear medicine and ECG technicians
Flexible schedule, allowing you to manage patient volume at your comfort level, with established demand and patient flow.

 

To apply: Send your CV to ***@mdsearch.ca (🔒 Premium).

jobs.full_description_text:
About Watson Medical Clinic

Watson Medical Clinic is a primary care practice dedicated to delivering comprehensive, patient-centered healthcare to the Forest Hill community and surrounding areas. Our collaborative team of physicians and allied health professionals is committed to clinical excellence, preventive care, and building lasting relationships with our patients.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled and dedicated Allergist/Immunologist to join our multidisciplinary team and expand our in-house specialty services.

Position Overview

The Allergist/Immunologist will work closely with our primary care physicians to evaluate, diagnose, and manage patients with allergic, asthmatic, and immunologic conditions. This is an exciting opportunity to build a thriving allergy practice within an established, well-supported clinic environment.




Key Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive evaluations and consultations for patients referred by our primary care physicians

• Diagnose and manage a broad range of allergic and immunologic conditions including asthma, allergic rhinitis, food allergies, eczema, urticaria, anaphylaxis, and primary immunodeficiency disorders

• Perform and interpret allergy skin testing, spirometry, pulmonary function tests, and other diagnostic procedures

• Develop and implement individualized treatment and immunotherapy plans

• Administer and oversee allergen immunotherapy (subcutaneous and sublingual)

• Collaborate with primary care physicians and other specialists to coordinate integrated patient care

• Maintain thorough and timely clinical documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR) system




Qualifications

Required

• Medical degree and valid medical license in Ontario (CPSO)

• Completion of an accredited Allergy & Immunology residency/fellowship program

• Certification or eligibility for certification with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (FRCPC) in Allergy & Immunology




What We Offer

• Flexible schedule

• Turnkey operation with full administrative support

• Fully equipped clinic with modern diagnostic equipment and EMR system (Telus PS Suite)

• Robust referral base from our team of 14 primary care physicians

• Collaborative, supportive, and team-oriented work environment

jobs.full_description_text:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated multidisciplinary medical centre founded in 2021 that has rapidly grown to over 55 physicians across multiple specialties. We are currently seeking part-time Internists or Internal Medicine Subspecialists like Hepatologists, Hematologists and Endocrinologists etc to join our expanding Internal Medicine team, with opportunities to work both virtually and in-person based on your preferred practice style and schedule.

With an established midtown Toronto location and planned expansion into Markham and Durham, Unify Health offers a modern, collaborative environment focused on efficient, patient-centred ambulatory care. New graduates are welcome.

The Opportunity

We are seeking Internists interested in flexible ambulatory Internal Medicine practice within a highly integrated multidisciplinary setting. Physicians can choose to work remotely, in person, or a combination of both, with approximately 80% of consultations able to be completed virtually on your own schedule.

Many physicians in the program are currently earning over $300 per hour remotely, with some exceeding this depending on availability, efficiency, and caseload.

You will have flexibility to tailor your practice to presentations you are most comfortable managing, with common referrals including:

Iron deficiency anemia
Minor hematologic abnormalities
Mild liver enzyme elevation/transaminitis
Leukopenia and other routine bloodwork abnormalities
General ambulatory Internal Medicine consultations

Our model is designed to maximize physician efficiency while maintaining high-quality patient care. Physicians benefit from:

Competitive split arrangements
Full administrative and scheduling support
Dedicated clinical assistant support
AI-assisted scribing/documentation tools
Prepared charts and preliminary organization completed by IMG clinical assistants
Access to in-house diagnostics including ECG, Holter monitoring, echocardiography, stress echocardiography, and POCUS

You will work collaboratively alongside on-site Cardiology, Family Medicine, Allergy, Dermatology, ENT, Plastic Surgery, and allied health teams within a truly integrated care environment.

Flexible Practice Model

Choose how and when you want to work. Physicians have the ability to build a practice that fits their lifestyle, whether primarily remote, hybrid, or in-person.

Strong Earning Potential

Efficient ambulatory consultative medicine with substantial administrative support allows many physicians to generate strong hourly earnings while maintaining schedule flexibility. Most physicians making >$300 per hour remotely.

Collaborative Multidisciplinary Environment

Work alongside experienced Internists, Cardiologists, Surgeons, Allergists, Family Doctors, Dermatologists, and other specialists in a collegial physician-led setting.

Modern Integrated Facility

Practice in a modern physician-owned facility designed to support both physician workflow and patient experience, with free parking and convenient central access. Midtown location with planned expansion to Markham and Durham region in the coming months.

Full Clinical Support

Dedicated clinical assistants, AI scribing tools, and streamlined workflows help reduce administrative burden and improve efficiency.

New Graduates Welcome
We welcome both experienced Internists and recent graduates looking to build a flexible and rewarding ambulatory Internal Medicine practice in a supportive environment.

Application Process: Interested candidates are encouraged to submit a CV, cover letter, and any relevant certifications to ***@unifyhelath.ca (🔒 Premium) .

Unify Health is looking for an Endocrinologist or General Internist with specialization, training, or meaningful experience in Obesity Medicine to join our growing multidisciplinary team.




We have a rapidly growing waitlist of patients seeking evidence-based management of obesity, metabolic syndrome, and related cardiometabolic disease. You would work alongside specialists in Cardiology, General Internal Medicine, Endocrinology, and other disciplines to provide comprehensive, medically appropriate care.

This is not a “GLP-1 dispensary.” Our focus is proper longitudinal medicine: assessment of contributing factors and comorbidities, individualized treatment plans, medication management when appropriate, monitoring, and coordinated multidisciplinary care.




The role is highly flexible. Care can be provided in person, virtually, or through a combination of both, at the physician’s discretion. Hours are flexible, with strong administrative and clinical support.




What we offer:

• Established and growing referral base

• Flexible scheduling

• In-person and virtual practice options

• Competitive physician split

• Potential earnings of >$300/hour from home, with higher earning potential depending on practice style and volume

• Accuro EMR

• AI scribe support

• Multidisciplinary specialist environment

• Physician-owned and physician-led clinic




We are especially interested in physicians who are passionate about high-quality obesity and metabolic medicine and want to help build a meaningful program rather than simply prescribe medications.

Please reach out to Unify Health cofounder Dr Darrell Ginsberg at ***@unifyhealth.ca (🔒 Premium) if interested in discussing the opportunity.

jobs.title: Hematologist Wanted for Multidisciplinary Clinic in Midtown Toronto
jobs.description_summary:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a broad team of allied health professionals. We are currently seeking a part-time, casual hematologist to join our growing integrated care model. Our centrally l...
jobs.full_description_text:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a broad team of allied health professionals. We are currently seeking a part-time, casual hematologist to join our growing integrated care model. Our centrally located clinic offers easy access, free parking, and a collegial environment that prioritizes high-quality, patient-centred care. We have a large and consistent referral base, and a significant proportion of consults and follow-ups can be managed virtually, allowing for an efficient and flexible outpatient practice.




The Role

We are seeking a hematologist with an interest in benign hematology to join our collaborative and multidisciplinary team at Unify Health. You will play a central role in the assessment and longitudinal management of patients with conditions such as anemia, cytopenias, iron deficiency, thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation issues, monoclonal gammopathies, and abnormal blood counts.




Our clinic is supported by experienced nursing staff and internationally trained clinical assistants who streamline investigations and follow-up, including coordination of laboratory testing, doing in-house iron infusions, coordinating imaging and referrals. Virtual care with most virtual physicians making $250-$500 per hour from home or clinic on a relaxed schedule. You will have full autonomy over referral criteria, diagnostic pathways, and case exclusions, with comprehensive administrative and clinical support. Opportunities also exist for collaboration with internal medicine, nephrology, cardiology, and other specialty teams as part of an integrated care approach.




Why Join Us?

Convenient Outpatient Practice: A well-supported, office and virtual-based hematology practice without inpatient or on-call obligations.
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a broad group of specialists within an integrated, physician-led care model.
Procedural Capability: Ability to perform in-clinic bone marrow biopsies with appropriate analgesia support.
Flexibility: Control over your schedule, patient volume, and clinic structure; we accommodate how and when you prefer to work.
Modern Facility: A purpose-built clinical space focused on efficiency, staff well-being, and patient experience.
Efficiency & Technology: Accuro EMR with pre-loaded templates and AI-supported documentation tools to reduce administrative burden.
Dedicated Support: Access to an individual clinical assistant to support workflow and patient coordination.
Billing Support: Mentorship in appropriate billing practices and access to a dedicated billing agent.

Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit a CV, cover letter, and any relevant certifications to ***@unifyhealth.ca (🔒 Premium) - We look forward to learning how your expertise in hematology could contribute to the continued growth of Unify Health.

jobs.full_description_text:
MDSearch is recruiting a non-invasive Cardiologist with a Nuclear Cardiology focus for an established community-based ambulatory cardiology clinic and diagnostic facility in midtown Toronto. The position is available on a full-time or part-time basis with flexible scheduling, making it an excellent opportunity for physicians seeking a rewarding clinical practice with genuine work-life balance.

The clinic is staffed by a group of university- and hospital-affiliated Cardiologists and Respirologists, and these institutional affiliations allow seamless continuity with upstream hospital-based cardiac services.

The Role

Provide comprehensive outpatient cardiology consultation and follow-up services
Serve as Quality Assurance (QA) Advisor for an accredited Nuclear Cardiology Laboratory
Oversee quality assurance activities within the lab's quality management program
Participate in protocol development and review, and monitor quality metrics
Ensure ongoing compliance with accreditation standards
Collaborate with Nuclear Medicine Technologists to promote excellence in patient care

About the Clinic

This professionally managed clinic is dedicated to delivering the highest quality patient care. A dedicated administrative team handles all clinical and administrative operations, allowing physicians to focus on what matters most — patient care.

Qualifications

Certification in Cardiology by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or equivalent acceptable for CPSO registration
Eligibility for independent or provisional licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario (CPSO)
Fellowship training and demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Cardiology (CBNC certification or Royal College certification in Nuclear Medicine)
Experience with Nuclear Cardiology laboratory quality assurance programs preferred
Full-time commitment preferred

This position combines a high-quality outpatient clinical practice with a leadership role in maintaining the quality and safety of a modern Nuclear Cardiology laboratory. Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Physician, Cancer-Related Fatigue Clinic
jobs.description_summary:
Why This Clinic Exists

Fatigue is the most commonly reported symptom in cancer and the one most likely to go untreated.

Patients raise it, are told it is normal, and leave with nothing. We built Cancer Fatigue Services because that gap should not exist.




CFS is Canada’s first physician-led, mul...
jobs.full_description_text:
Why This Clinic Exists

Fatigue is the most commonly reported symptom in cancer and the one most likely to go untreated.

Patients raise it, are told it is normal, and leave with nothing. We built Cancer Fatigue Services because that gap should not exist.




CFS is Canada’s first physician-led, multidisciplinary practice dedicated entirely to cancer-related fatigue.

Comprehensive medical assessment, cardiopulmonary exercise testing, supervised rehabilitation, and structured physician-led counselling, delivered as one coordinated longitudinal pathway.




Why We Are Speaking to You

Cancer-related fatigue is a differential diagnosis problem, and that is your discipline. Anemia. Thyroid dysfunction. Hypogonadism. Adrenal insufficiency. Sleep-disordered breathing. Treatment-related cardiotoxicity. Medication burden. Deconditioning. Mood. Any of them can produce profound exhaustion in a survivor, several are usually operating at once, and someone has to work through the list. Almost nobody does, which is why these patients arrive years after treatment ended having been told their bloodwork is fine.

The physiology is measured, not estimated. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing at baseline and reassessment gives you integrated cardiac, pulmonary, and metabolic data on a symptom assessed almost everywhere else by questionnaire.
Late treatment effects are an expanding clinical problem. Cardiovascular, pulmonary, endocrine sequelae, and metabolic consequences of long-term therapy are all growing as survival improves. There is room to build genuine expertise here.
It is ambulatory and scheduled. No ward service, no consult pager, no call, no weekends.




The Role

Conduct comprehensive fatigue assessments covering presentation, oncologic and treatment history, symptom characterization, and functional status.
Lead results delivery encounters and build the shared care plan with the patient and the team.
Deliver the structured counselling encounters that anchor the care model. Session materials, scripts, workbooks, and documentation templates are built and in active use.
Provide medical oversight to the rehabilitation and psychosocial teams.
Coordinate ongoing care with referring oncologists, primary care providers, and other specialists.




We Do Healthcare Differently

We treat patients better by carrying the burden of navigating the system instead of handing it back to them. We treat clinicians the same way. High volumes with no downtime are how care quality erodes and how good physicians burn out, so we have built the clinic around concrete commitments:

Administrative support, human and technological, so your attention stays on the patient.
Fifteen to sixty minutes of team support attached to every encounter.
Administrative time scheduled into your day, not appended to it.
A buffer between encounters, set to your preference.
You set your own schedule. We ask only for consistency week to week.
No call, no after-hours coverage, no inpatient responsibility.

Leave your work at work. We have built the clinic so that is actually possible.




Terms

Compensation: You keep 65% on comprehensive assessments and 70% on every other encounter type.
Commitment: Our physicians work anywhere from three full days to two half-days per week. No minimum.
Delivery: First OHIP-covered encounter on-site, most follow-ups virtual.




Qualifications

MD or equivalent, active and unrestricted CPSO licence, CMPA coverage, OHIP billing number.
Demonstrated diagnostic skill with complex, multi-system presentations.
 Strong communication skills, particularly in conversations about function, loss, and expectation setting.
Comfort in a multidisciplinary team and with structured, templated documentation.
Assets: FRCPC in Internal Medicine, or a subspecialty background in cardiology, respirology, endocrinology, geriatrics, or physical medicine and rehabilitation. Experience interpreting cardiopulmonary exercise testing. Interest in clinical research.

About Watson Medical Clinic

jobs.full_description_text:
About Watson Medical Clinic

Watson Medical Clinic is a primary care practice dedicated to delivering comprehensive, patient-centered healthcare to the Forest Hill community and surrounding areas. Our collaborative team of physicians and allied health professionals is committed to clinical excellence, preventive care, and building lasting relationships with our patients.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled and dedicated Allergist/Immunologist to join our multidisciplinary team and expand our in-house specialty services.

Position Overview

The Allergist/Immunologist will work closely with our primary care physicians to evaluate, diagnose, and manage patients with allergic, asthmatic, and immunologic conditions. This is an exciting opportunity to build a thriving allergy practice within an established, well-supported clinic environment.




Key Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive evaluations and consultations for patients referred by our primary care physicians

• Diagnose and manage a broad range of allergic and immunologic conditions including asthma, allergic rhinitis, food allergies, eczema, urticaria, anaphylaxis, and primary immunodeficiency disorders

• Perform and interpret allergy skin testing, spirometry, pulmonary function tests, and other diagnostic procedures

• Develop and implement individualized treatment and immunotherapy plans

• Administer and oversee allergen immunotherapy (subcutaneous and sublingual)

• Collaborate with primary care physicians and other specialists to coordinate integrated patient care

• Maintain thorough and timely clinical documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR) system




Qualifications

Required

jobs.full_description_text:
MDSearch is recruiting a non-invasive Cardiologist with a Nuclear Cardiology focus for an established community-based ambulatory cardiology clinic and diagnostic facility in midtown Toronto. The position is available on a full-time or part-time basis with flexible scheduling, making it an excellent opportunity for physicians seeking a rewarding clinical practice with genuine work-life balance.

The clinic is staffed by a group of university- and hospital-affiliated Cardiologists and Respirologists, and these institutional affiliations allow seamless continuity with upstream hospital-based cardiac services.

The Role

Provide comprehensive outpatient cardiology consultation and follow-up services
Serve as Quality Assurance (QA) Advisor for an accredited Nuclear Cardiology Laboratory
Oversee quality assurance activities within the lab's quality management program
Participate in protocol development and review, and monitor quality metrics
Ensure ongoing compliance with accreditation standards
Collaborate with Nuclear Medicine Technologists to promote excellence in patient care

About the Clinic

This professionally managed clinic is dedicated to delivering the highest quality patient care. A dedicated administrative team handles all clinical and administrative operations, allowing physicians to focus on what matters most — patient care.

Qualifications

Certification in Cardiology by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or equivalent acceptable for CPSO registration
Eligibility for independent or provisional licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario (CPSO)
Fellowship training and demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Cardiology (CBNC certification or Royal College certification in Nuclear Medicine)
Experience with Nuclear Cardiology laboratory quality assurance programs preferred
Full-time commitment preferred

This position combines a high-quality outpatient clinical practice with a leadership role in maintaining the quality and safety of a modern Nuclear Cardiology laboratory. Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.description_summary:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a broad team of allied health professionals. We are currently seeking a part-time, casual hematologist to join our growing integrated care model. Our centrally l...
jobs.full_description_text:
About Unify Health

Unify Health is a physician-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary ambulatory medical centre with over 50 physicians and a broad team of allied health professionals. We are currently seeking a part-time, casual hematologist to join our growing integrated care model. Our centrally located clinic offers easy access, free parking, and a collegial environment that prioritizes high-quality, patient-centred care. We have a large and consistent referral base, and a significant proportion of consults and follow-ups can be managed virtually, allowing for an efficient and flexible outpatient practice.




The Role

We are seeking a hematologist with an interest in benign hematology to join our collaborative and multidisciplinary team at Unify Health. You will play a central role in the assessment and longitudinal management of patients with conditions such as anemia, cytopenias, iron deficiency, thrombocytopenia, anticoagulation issues, monoclonal gammopathies, and abnormal blood counts.




Our clinic is supported by experienced nursing staff and internationally trained clinical assistants who streamline investigations and follow-up, including coordination of laboratory testing, doing in-house iron infusions, coordinating imaging and referrals. Virtual care with most virtual physicians making $250-$500 per hour from home or clinic on a relaxed schedule. You will have full autonomy over referral criteria, diagnostic pathways, and case exclusions, with comprehensive administrative and clinical support. Opportunities also exist for collaboration with internal medicine, nephrology, cardiology, and other specialty teams as part of an integrated care approach.




Why Join Us?

Convenient Outpatient Practice: A well-supported, office and virtual-based hematology practice without inpatient or on-call obligations.
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a broad group of specialists within an integrated, physician-led care model.
Procedural Capability: Ability to perform in-clinic bone marrow biopsies with appropriate analgesia support.
Flexibility: Control over your schedule, patient volume, and clinic structure; we accommodate how and when you prefer to work.
Modern Facility: A purpose-built clinical space focused on efficiency, staff well-being, and patient experience.
Efficiency & Technology: Accuro EMR with pre-loaded templates and AI-supported documentation tools to reduce administrative burden.
Dedicated Support: Access to an individual clinical assistant to support workflow and patient coordination.
Billing Support: Mentorship in appropriate billing practices and access to a dedicated billing agent.

Application Process

Interested candidates are invited to submit a CV, cover letter, and any relevant certifications to ***@unifyhealth.ca (🔒 Premium) - We look forward to learning how your expertise in hematology could contribute to the continued growth of Unify Health.

jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor - Academic Transplant Hepatologist
jobs.description_summary: The Department of Medicine, Temerty Faculty of Medicine at the University of Toronto and the Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology of the University Health Network (UHN) and Sinai Health (SH) is seeking to recruit to the internationally recognized Ajmera Transplant Centre, a permanent, full-ti...
jobs.full_description_text:
The Department of Medicine, Temerty Faculty of Medicine at the University of Toronto and the Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology of the University Health Network (UHN) and Sinai Health (SH) is seeking to recruit to the internationally recognized Ajmera Transplant Centre, a permanent, full-time Academic Transplant Hepatologist. The successful candidate must be eligible for a full-time clinical academic appointment with an academic position description of Clinician Investigator, at the rank of Assistant or Associate Professor at the University of Toronto. Effective start date is September 1, 2026, or shortly thereafter.

The successful candidate must hold a MD degree, or equivalent, and Fellowship certification with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or equivalent, to be eligible to practice hepatology in Ontario, Canada. The successful candidate must have or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario.

The successful candidate must demonstrate advanced training in Transplant Hepatology and Transplant Oncology with experience in the inpatient and outpatient care of complex liver transplant candidates and recipients. The successful candidate will spend approximately 50% of their time in clinical work related to liver transplantation and transplant oncology. There might also be cross coverage of the kidney-pancreas inpatient service. The remaining time will be spent in research and teaching. The candidate will be appointed Clinician-Investigator and expected to develop an academic program in transplant oncology and related clinical and translational research. The desirable academic qualities of the successful candidate would include an appropriate graduate degree (MSc, PhD or equivalent), fellowship training, relevant grants, and publications and/or a proven track record and accomplishments in transplant oncology research consistent with a Clinician Investigator academic role. The candidate will also contribute to the clinical fellowship program in transplant hepatology, working alongside clinician educators within the group.

The Ajmera Transplant Centre performs 200 liver transplants annually. The successful candidate will join our existing group of five transplant hepatologists in the Ajmera Transplant Centre which is supported by a large multidisciplinary team of abdominal transplant surgeons, medical and surgical transplant fellows, nurse practitioners, nurse coordinators, allied health professionals and administrative staff. 

The Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology of the UHN and SH is a group of 33 luminal gastroenterologists and hepatologists. The Division has active clinical and academic programs in many areas of gastroenterology and hepatology including viral hepatitis, autoimmune liver disease, fatty liver disease, portal hypertension, hepatocellular carcinoma and liver transplantation as well as IBD, nutrition, pancreatic cancer, neurogastroenterology and motility.

The UHN includes Toronto General, Toronto Western, Princess Margaret and Toronto Rehab Hospitals, as well as the Michener Institute. UHN is a Canada’s leading research academic hospital. Building on the strengths and reputation of each of its programs, UHN brings together the talent and resources needed to achieve global impact and provide exemplary patient care, research and education. SH is a health care organization comprised of Mount Sinai Hospital, Bridgepoint Active Healthcare and Circle of Care as an affiliate, extending SH’s continuum of care into home and community programs. The SH vision is to create a premier exemplar of an integrated health system for the future.

Depending on the academic rank, qualifications and experience, remuneration will be at least in the range of $250,000-$350,000 through the Department of Medicine's Academic Practice Plan. Medical and dental benefits are available. The successful candidate may be eligible to apply for a donor-named Professorship.

Applications will be accepted until July 13, 2026, or until the position is filled. The anticipated start date will be mutually agreed upon. Should you be interested in this opportunity, please forward a letter of interest (LOI) and up-to-date curriculum vitae, and the names and contact information of three referees to:

Ms. Mona Pio (***@uhn.ca (🔒 Premium)) Administrative Assistant, AND

Dr. Deepali Kumar (***@uhn.ca (🔒 Premium)), Director of Ajmera Transplant Centre at UHN 

Diversity Statement

The University of Toronto embraces Diversity and is building a culture of belonging that increases our capacity to effectively address and serve the interests of our global community. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, Black and racialized persons, women, persons with disabilities, and people of diverse sexual and gender identities. We value applicants who have demonstrated a commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion and recognize that diverse perspectives, experiences, and expertise are essential to strengthening our academic mission.

Accessibility Statement

The University strives to be an equitable and inclusive community, and proactively seeks to increase diversity among its community members. Our values regarding equity and diversity are linked with our unwavering commitment to excellence in the pursuit of our academic mission.

The University is committed to the principles of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). As such, we strive to make our recruitment, assessment and selection processes as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for applicants with disabilities.

If you require any accommodations at any point during the application and hiring process, please contact ***@utoronto.ca (🔒 Premium).
